name: scene-feedback-harness
description: Review reference images and reconstructed scenes, annotate visual errors, and deliver image feedback through MCP tools and events.

defaultPrompt: 进入人工调试模式，让我在参考图和当前场景上指出问题。
Review this reconstruction with annotated visual feedback.
interface.longDescription: Compare reference images with reconstructed 3D scenes, mark visual errors, and share original and annotated evidence through a project-specific MCP service. Type @ in one prompt to reference the currently selected object or part and this round’s unsent annotations. Type / to insert exact frame times or time spans automatically collected from the current clip and this round’s marked evidence; editing times are expressed in the prompt. Drag images or use evidence buttons to add other visual references. The scene view uses one row of compact cards: interactive 3D first, followed by frozen screenshots in capture order. Cards smoothly expand in place on mouse hover or visible keyboard focus; touchscreens keep compact cards for direct taps. Reference annotation tools appear on image hover, keyboard focus or a touch tap. Overlay opacity, ground direction and reference camera alignment are directly available in the scene toolbar. Drawing on live 3D automatically freezes the current view and completes the same gesture on its screenshot. Further marks stay on that image; returning to 3D and drawing again creates another screenshot while retaining earlier evidence. The workbench supports multiple camera views, dynamic frames, imported WholeBody133 evidence and manual hand keypoint corrections. Human reconstruction and tracking run in a separate capsule skill. Experimental MCP Events delivery requires a supporting host and a verified subscription.
